summary: A 30-byte message digest selects 14 FORS leaves and one path through seven XMSS layers. FORS reconstructs a 16-byte key; seven WOTS+/Merkle proofs authenticate it to the 16-byte public root.

facts.label: Signature
facts.value: R 16 B + FORS 2,912 B + hypertree 4,928 B = 7,856 B

facts.label: Message digest
facts.value: 30 B → 14 × 12-bit FORS indices + 54-bit tree index + 9-bit leaf index

facts.label: FORS
facts.value: 14 trees, height 12; per tree: 16 B secret + 12 × 16 B siblings = 208 B

facts.label: XMSS hypertree
facts.value: 7 layers, height 9 each; per layer: 35 × 16 B WOTS+ values + 9 × 16 B siblings = 704 B
